Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied transparent 3D cutaway home illustration to correct implausible maintenance details. Preserve EXACT 1377x1142 canvas, house silhouette and size, roof, camera, two-storey four-room composition, blue/white palette, warm lighting, appliance locations and four Vietnamese technicians. Do not redesign the website or add text. Output true transparent alpha outside the building and trees.

Correct only these areas:
1. Upper-left AC: white wall split AC with FRONT COVER OPEN UPWARD on its actual hinge, exposing removable mesh filters. Technician stands balanced on a realistic fully opened A-frame stepladder with a broad lower standing step, all feet flat on tile in the clear space in front of sofa, not on furniture; both feet on a step BELOW the top cap. His hands visibly hold one removable filter next to its filter slot for inspection. No powered drill into the air outlet, no fused fingers, no awkward overreach. Keep him roughly at the original center-left.
2. Upper-right washer: front-load washer with recognizably circular hinged door opened toward left about 50 degrees; drum visible. Kneeling technician inspects the rubber door gasket with his fingertips and a small flashlight, rather than poking a closed glass door or fake controls. Unpowered inspection, dry floor, realistic hand placement and tool size, no detached floating parts. Maintain original washer and technician positions.
3. Lower-left fridge: conventional tall silver fridge, recognizable fridge doors; open ONE upper refrigerator door about 40 degrees to expose white interior shelves. Technician kneels in front and checks the rubber door seal along the lower edge of that OPEN door. Remove the dispenser-poking gesture and any device apparently drilling into a closed door. Correct hinge geometry, door clearance and realistic appliance proportions; hands connect naturally to wrists.
4. Lower-right water heater: simple domestic wall-mounted electric storage water heater. Show TWO distinct tidy short water connections under the tank, conventional isolation fittings and clean wall routing. Remove the current impossible looping/braided spaghetti pipes and powered tool near water. Kneeling technician visually checks a visible exterior connection with a small flashlight, other hand relaxed on knee; no drilling, no bare electrical wiring or sparks, no fake hose through the wall.
5. Fix upper-left balcony glass: straight clean glass railing with consistent metal frame, no black ghost mark, melted panel, hole or background-erasure residue. All floor edges and railing posts join solid surfaces; retain the balcony outline.
6. All uniforms: consistent royal-blue shirt/navy trousers, sensible closed shoes, no nonsense lettering. Use plain shirts with a SMALL WHITE UNLETTERED rectangular patch on upper back; no pseudo-Vietnamese words, no brand labels on appliances.
Keep all other geometry unchanged, sharp professional architectural illustration, realistic anatomy, no huge wrench, no extra workers, no labels, no UI. Maintain existing transparent margins, not an opaque backdrop.
targeted_fix: Targeted correction edit on this updated house illustration. Preserve every room, worker pose, appliance position, geometry, canvas size and all other pixels as closely as possible. Correct ONLY the visible plumbing below the lower-right water heater: the current U-shaped tube incorrectly joins the hot and cold outlets together. REMOVE that U-shaped bridge completely. Render TWO SHORT SEPARATE water connections. Each starts at its own bottom tank fitting, passes its own small red or blue isolation fitting, then independently bends BACK INTO THE WALL at its own separate round wall escutcheon. The hot and cold lines must NEVER touch or connect to each other in view. No looping hose and no open ends. Keep the kneeling worker's flashlight pointing toward the separate fittings. Also clean the transparent outer silhouette of the building/trees: remove all stray white/cyan specks, white rectangular erasure patches and detached pixel noise outside the architecture, while retaining naturally antialiased edges and foliage. True transparent alpha outside. No added text, no brand changes, no other redesign, no reframing. Exact same 1377x1142 high-resolution canvas.
